messages:
carlos_support: Heads-up: ACME reporting a sharp p99 spike against their Dedicated pool 'acme-west-2-pool' since ~22:10 UTC. p95 jumped from ~90ms -> 450ms, p99 ~2.1s. We're also seeing intermittent 502/504 and attach timeouts. Escalation INC-4321.

alice_custsuc: Ack, pinging @ben_sre and @dana_oncall. This is affecting a checkout flow, high priority.

ben_sre: Looking. Can you drop the recent metrics (attach queue, warm GPU counts, scale ops) and any relevant logs?

carlos_support: Metric snapshot (22:12 UTC):
```
pool: acme-west-2-pool
inflight_requests: 420
attach_queue: 68
attach_latency_p99: 2100ms
gpu_warm: 2/10 (min=2 desired=10)
scaleup_ops: throttled (fairshare)
recent_deploy: autoscale-policy v2.3 (21:58 UTC)
```

dana_oncall: Thanks. Initial hypothesis: autoscaler got fairshare-throttled during a burst + image pulls slowed, leading to cold-GPU attach backlog. Hotattach wasn't enabled on this pool and min_ready is low (2). I'll run the attach-controller playbook and start mitigation.

ben_sre: Short mitigation checklist: 1) bump min_ready to 5 for acme-west-2-pool (manual) 2) enable hotattach on the hotpool 3) temporarily route ACME traffic to hosted fallback model for critical endpoints 4) increase reserved capacity if available 5) restart attach-controller if queue doesn't drain in 3m.

carlos_support: :point_up: Can we do (1) and (2) immediately? Customer needs immediate relief.

dana_oncall: On it. Patching pool and toggling hotattach now. Posting commands I'm running: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch deployment attach-controller -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"attach","env":[{"name":"HOTATTACH_ENABLED","value":"true"}]}]}}}}'
redwoodctl pools update acme-west-2-pool --min-ready=5
```

infra-bot: Action: pool update started for acme-west-2-pool (job: 9982). Progress: 0/8 GPUs ready.

ben_sre: If image pulls are the bottleneck consider a forced warmup / pre-pull: `redwoodctl warmup acme-west-2-pool --models gpt-opus-7b` Also check container registry latency in that region.

carlos_support: Customer reports initial improvement: p95 down to ~230ms, p99 down to ~1.1s. Still seeing occasional 5xx on heavy requests. I updated INC-4321.

dana_oncall: Monitoring trends. If p99 doesn't continue to drop in 10m we'll escalate to infra to add reserved nodes. Capturing attach-controller logs now for root cause: looking for fairshare throttles and image-pull timeouts.

ben_sre: Follow-ups: ben_sre -> run repro harness to simulate ramp and validate autoscaler changes; dana_oncall -> collect attach-controller logs + validate hotattach rollout; carlos_support -> confirm SLA impact window and customer comms. :thumbsup:

alice_custsuc: Thanks all — I'll send a short customer update and postmortem template once metrics stabilize.
